title: Good sheet, poor strategy.
text: Good sheet, poor strategy.. Looks like a great cookie sheet.  However; they put a glob of glue on the front to secure the instructions and picture.  What sadists!  So far, I haven't been able to remove it.  I'd give four stars to the product, two to the glue placer.
